purpose.en: Stretch the tops of your feet and the front of your shins.

text.zh: 跪姿脚背贴地，重心慢慢向后移
text.en: Kneel with the tops of your feet down and shift your weight back slowly

text.zh: 脚背和小腿前侧有拉伸感就停
text.en: Stop when you feel the stretch on the tops of your feet and shins.

text.zh: 保持呼吸，再慢慢回到起始

commonErrors.en: Sitting back too heavily at once.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 膝盖或脚背不适时垫软垫或减小幅度
cautions.en: Pad your knees or reduce the range if your knees or feet feel uncomfortable.
